answer_1.quote: we propose AV-TranSpeech, introducing the first AV-S2ST system without using text.

answer_2.quote: For translation accuracy, we use open-sourced ASR models in fairseq framework to transcribe the audios and then calculate the BLEU score between the generated and the reference text.

answer_4.quote: To evaluate the naturalness of the speech output, we conduct crowd-sourced human evaluations with MOS, rated from 1 to 5 and reported with 95% confidence intervals (CI) via Amazon Mechanical Turk.
answer_4.guideline: Raters were asked to score naturalness on a scale from 1 to 5
